title: Storage Rental Offer Terms: First-Month Promotion and Prepayment Discount
content:
Five of the six Storage Rental products carry a promotional discount on the first full month's rent, against a minimum rental commitment, and four carry a discount on prepaid months, earned when a set number of months is prepaid together.

| Storage Rental product | First-month promotion (share of the first full month's rent) | Rental months committed to receive the promotion | Months prepaid together to earn the prepay discount | Prepay discount (share of each prepaid month) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bike Storage Locker | 0% | 0 | 0 | 0% |
| Small Storage Closet (4x4) | 50% | 3 | 0 | 0% |
| Standard Storage Unit (5x5) | 50% | 3 | 6 | 5% |
| Large Storage Unit (5x10) | 50% | 3 | 6 | 5% |
| Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) | 50% | 3 | 6 | 5% |
| Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | 100% | 6 | 12 | 8% |

As decimal fractions, the promotion is 0.00 for the Bike Storage Locker, 0.5 for the four middle products and 1.00 for the Oversized Storage Suite (10x10); the prepay discount is 0.00, 0.05 or 0.08.

**Terms of the table**

- A figure of 0 in the prepaid-months column means the product has no prepay discount. The Bike Storage Locker and the Small Storage Closet (4x4) therefore carry no prepay discount.
- The Bike Storage Locker carries no first-month promotion (0%).
- The Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) promotion is 100% of the first full month's rent and requires a 6-month commitment; its prepay discount requires 12 months prepaid together.

**Illustrative figures** (hypothetical rentals whose rent in force is the amount shown)

| Storage Rental product | Hypothetical rent in force | Promotion on the first full month | Prepay discount on one prepaid month |
|---|---|---|---|
| Small Storage Closet (4x4) | $35.00 | $17.50 | none |
| Standard Storage Unit (5x5) | $55.00 | $27.50 | $2.75 |
| Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | $165.00 | $165.00 | $13.20 |
